key_insight: OmniTongue exposes substantial gaps in multimodal AI’s ability to interpret fine-grained tongue features in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM).
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports research on automated TCM tongue assessment but does not establish clinical diagnostic validity or readiness.
method: Constructed a visual question-answering benchmark from expert-validated tongue images.
Covered 16 clinical dimensions and 66 fine-grained labels.
Added region-specific annotations to evaluate feature localization.
evidence_signal: Evaluation using 1,351 images and 21,616 instruction pairs found no domain advantage for medical-specific models and broadly poor Macro-F1 scores.
watch_item: Poor Macro-F1 scores raise concerns about statistical shortcuts, and the abstract provides no evidence of prospective clinical validation.
paper_title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
